senses.definition: A narrow band of fast-moving air high in the sky.
senses.example: The plane flew with the jet stream and arrived sooner.

senses.definition: A puzzle made of pieces whose edges fit together, usually forming a picture when all the pieces are in place.
senses.example: We found the corner pieces of the jigsaw puzzle first.
Your elbow is a joint that lets your arm bend.

senses.definition: A group chosen to hear information and make a decision in a court case.
senses.example: The jury listened to the witnesses before making its decision.
